answer: Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 110 aliases, and each one needs its own funded reef account. Deposits are visible in pigment, and beacon reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 27% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Every extra alias adds 2 hours of verification and 27 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
